text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 7,000 candidates to start campaign on Thursday for June 5 parliamentary election.
- At least 11 "terrorists" killed on Tuesday in western region of Saida in security forces operation.

- Movement for Democracy in Algeria, opposition party founded by former president Ben Bella, risks being outlawed as authorities say it failed to change manifesto in line with new party law. MDA, boycotting election, insists its platform fits into new law.
- Some of 200 foreign observers arrive in Algiers to prepare to oversee parliamentary elections.
